title: Vijayan demands withdrawal of circular allowing colleges to increase seats without Keralam Govt nod
summary: The CPI(M) veteran said a September 11 circular issued by the Higher Education Department had made prior government approval mandatory for introducing new courses and increasing seats in government, aided and autonomous colleges

title: Congress donations fall nearly 75%, sharpest decline in a decade
summary: Congress had received ₹517.39 crore in such contributions in 2024-25, according to its 2024-25 contribution report submitted to the Election Commission of India

title: Dangerous harmonies: Is there a hidden villain in India’s devastating electrical fires?
summary: Electrical causes are predominating in India’s recent fire incidents; while codes and guidelines are covering these increasingly, there are still major gaps such as taking into account harmonic currents put into the system by state-of-the-art electronics equipment
